title: assure
description: Starts the assure command line: reads the subcommand and its flags, runs assure record (ST-ASR-CLI01), assure gate change (ST-ASR-CLI02) or assure gate release (ST-ASR-CLI03), and exits with its code: 0 when it did its work or the commit passed, 1 when it refused or record failed, 2 when it was called wrongly or the gate cannot decide.
